description: This file defines functions to create various UI card components for media control, Apple TV remote, and device control, using Flex components. It includes functions for media player cards, Apple TV remote cards, and device control cards, with detailed layout and styling logic.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerCard
methods.description: Creates a media player UI card with album art, playback controls, and status indicators.

methods.name: createAppleTvRemoteCard
methods.description: Creates an Apple TV remote control card with directional pad, menu, home, playback, and volume controls.

methods.name: createDeviceControlCard
methods.description: Creates a device control card with status indicator and control buttons arranged in a grid.
